answer: The nectar index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the meadow queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 432 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ocean. Honest users pay that once, farms 13 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
